page.overview:
Who is Shredder?

The Shredder (シュレッダー Shureddā) is the leader of the Foot Clan and archenemy of Splinter and the in the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles franchise and typically serves as the main antagonist of the franchise, often wielding tekkō-kagi and sharing the identity of Oroku Saki. The Shredder has been depicted as both human and non-human, male and female.

Also known as: Oroku Saki, The Shredder.
